patterns.name: wazuh_correlated_ssh_brute_force

condition.documentedRuleMeaning: Wazuh SSH correlation: eight failed logins from one source IP in two minutes
condition.note: Confirm the official rule identity; do not replace correlated evidence with rule.firedtimes or rule.level.

patterns.rationale: Wazuh documents rule 5712 for eight failed SSH logins from one IP within two minutes; repetitive password guessing matches MITRE T1110.001.

patterns.name: repeated_failures_same_source_and_account

condition.note: A single Wazuh alert must itself contain verified aggregation evidence; without it this pattern is not confirmed.

patterns.rationale: Repeated authentication failures concentrated on one account within a bounded interval indicate potential password guessing under MITRE T1110.001.

patterns.name: failures_across_multiple_accounts

condition.note: This is a password-spraying indicator, not proof the same password was reused; never inspect or log credentials.

patterns.rationale: Authentication failures from one source against many accounts in a short interval can indicate password spraying under MITRE T1110.003.

guardrails: No credential values are stored, compared, or printed.
rule.firedtimes alone is not the number of failures by the same source within a bounded interval.
Without evidence of an actual time window, source correlation, and failed attempts, do not treat a high rule level as confirmed brute force.
Any unverified aggregation field names or quantitative thresholds must be checked against the supplied Wazuh fixture before enforcing blocks.
